title: S3.7c face-loop coedge-to-loop and pcurve incidence
scope: Expose each loop-ordered coedge's owning-loop pointer
Expose each loop-ordered coedge's optional pcurve pointer
Retain exact per-coedge alignment with identity, edge, and sense rows

implementation.unknownDisposition: Null, absent, unsupported-profile, or untyped targets remain -1. A coedge loop link that does not equal the containing projected loop marks known-gap coverage. Null pcurve is retained as optional absence.
implementation.resourceAccounting: Each cache row charges one output item per emitted pointer slot; each per-face copied row is charged before copying; each source coedge link lookup charges extraction work.
implementation.compatibility: Public DRW_AcisFaceLoop layout changes and requires downstream rebuild; DRW_Interface and its 2D callback lane are unchanged.

positive: Generated multi-loop graph preserves exact per-coedge owning-loop identities
Generated multi-loop graph preserves one pcurve identity and explicit null pcurve slots
Parser-fed SAB projection matches the in-memory graph rows
negative: Null coedge owning-loop pointer remains -1 while coedge identity is retained
Owning-loop absence classifies projected output as having a known gap
Existing wrong-type/out-of-range pointer matrix still refuses malformed graph references

method.limitations: Pointer slots are read only from the admitted SAB 21800 model and validated against the expected node family. A pcurve pointer identity is structural reference capture only and is not curve or trim evaluation.
